title: Polarization at the positive coordinate value
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{-1,1\\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate and $x$ a point of the sign cube. The coordinate polarization of $f$, evaluated at the point obtained from $x$ by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$, equals the maximum of the values of $f$ at the two points obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$ and to $-1$.
